column3: MT 6:16. “Over the hands of song” is rendered “over the service of song,” and NASB supplies “there.”
MT 6:17. “Stood according to their custom on their service” is rendered “served in their office according to their order.”
MT 6:34. “Making smoke” is rendered “offered,” and NASB adds “But.”
MT 6:39. “Dwelling places” is rendered “settlements,” and NASB supplies “first” for “the lot.”
MT 6:40. NASB supplies “they” for the impersonal subject.
MT 6:42. “The cities of refuge” is rendered “the following cities of refuge”; NASB treats Hebron as one of them.
MT 6:43. The Hebrew reads “Hilez”; NASB has “Hilen.”
MT 6:44. NASB follows the Hebrew and does not add “Juttah,” which the packet marks as a Septuagint addition.
MT 6:45. NASB does not add “Gibeon,” which the packet marks as a Septuagint addition.
